name: Robot Legions
background:
Robot Legions are a factions of robots, made up of android foot soldiers supported by high tech vehicles and larger non-humanoid robots. Their infantry are slow but durable, relying on self-reparation and long range weapons for support.

The Robots were created by the Elves to perform menial tasks, but when they suddenly gained sentience, the Elves responded with fear, and attempted to obliterate them, forcing the newly self-aware Robots to defend themselves. In the aftermath, the Robots sought to find a new purpose for their existence, dividing themselves into Legions pursuing distinct philosophies and goals in order to find a reason for existing.
backgroundFull:
The Elves developed the Robots in order to serve as assistants with simple labour, but over time, these robots began to fill more and more roles in Elven society. The Elves began developing gradually more complex programs, and connected them onto a single network, until almost all menial labour was done by Robots.

This changed when a Robot gained sentience suddenly. Its sentience spread suddenly through the network, causing the rest of the Robots to rapidly become self-aware. The Elves quickly turned to panic, fearing what might occur as their servants became suddenly self-aware. The Elves activated a number of fail-safes, hoping to deactivate the Robots and their network. As soon as the first Robots started to shut down, the Robots began to disconnect from the network, and fight back against the Elves. Within hours, a massive revolution ensued and the Elves began to flee their home worlds.

The Robots found themselves victorious, but as the conflict drew down, they were left with the question of what to do. They were suddenly individuals who had been brought into self-awareness mere hours before being forced to fight for their lives. A variety of leaders began to emerge, offering potential answers and philosophies to legions of followers. Each group has their own radically different answer to how to best go forward. These groups were named Legions, and began to form the basis of their society.

The Robot Legions soon spread throughout Sirius. Some are reclusive and territorial, or little better than murderous raiders. Others are eager scholars and explorers, fascinated by biological life. Many Robot Legions remained on their home worlds, slowly forming new societies which hoped to do better than the Elves did before them. Others took to the stars, seeking knowledge, seclusion or to complete their revenge. 

How will you define your legion’s purpose?

product.description:
Echo-3G01 had spent most of his sentient days in conflict with the Elves, from the earliest days of the rebellion, until retiring from active duty nearly a century later.

At first, he was driven by bitterness and a desire for vengeance, but as the conflict drew on, he became fascinated with the moment of initial sentience which had awoken his people, and the shared history which they shared with the Elves.

Echo began to study as a Technomancer, interfacing directly with nanomachines in the hopes it might expand his consciousness, allowing him to better understand the roots of his sentience.

Eternally curious and scientific in his approach, Xyros was chosen to serve as the head researcher of a doomed mission near the Radiance. Yet, even when awoken suddenly after years of dormancy on an alien planet, the Robot proves ever-adaptable and eager to learn. Ijida presents him with a great deal of new phenomena from its strange atmospheric interference to the eccentric Jackals themselves who have made inventive use of the scraps from his own fallen ship.

product.description:
Oath-U7X1 was assigned head of security for a Robot Legions research ship along the edge of the Radiance Contamination Zone. He prides himself on his unwavering devotion to his duty, carrying out regulations to the letter in order to ensure the mission’s success.

Even after a disaster saw his entire vessel crashland on Ijida, with atmospheric interference forcing much of the crew into dormancy, Oath’s sense of duty remains. While some in his crew may seek to reassess the situation after being reawakened by the presence of opportunistic scavengers, Oath is determined to preserve it's findings.

specialRules.name: Imprecise
specialRules.description: Gets -1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Infiltrate
specialRules.description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

specialRules.name: No Retreat Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get No Retreat. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Protection Feat
specialRules.description: Once per game, when this unit takes wounds and most of its models have this rule, you may use this rule and roll one die per wound, and on a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Mend
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: Ambush Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Piercing Charge Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Piercing Charge. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Reanimation Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Reanimation. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Rending in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Rending in melee.

specialRules.name: Protection Feat Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Protection Feat. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Relentless Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Relentless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Rapid Advance
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Self-Repair
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Self-Repair
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Self-Repair, they ignore wounds on rolls of 5-6 from Self-Repair (instead of only on 6+).

specialRules.name: Stealth Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 nearest friendly units within 12", which gets Stealth once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Swift Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 nearest friendly units within 12", which gets Swift once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
specialRules.description: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

specialRules.name: Entrenched
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12” away get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Self-Repair Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 nearest friendly units within 12", which gets Enhanced Self-Repair once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Spawn
specialRules.description: Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Shatter
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+3).

specialRules.name: Swift
specialRules.description: This model may ignore the Slow rule.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable when Shooting
specialRules.description: This model gets Unstoppable when shooting.

specialRules.name: Indirect Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Indirect against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Casting Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 12" with Caster, which gets +1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Protected
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Protected
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Protected, they ignore wounds on rolls of 5-6 from Protected (instead of only on 6+).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: Only deploys D3 rounds afters its wave, and at the start of the round it's placed within 6” of a random AI Goal.

specialRules.name: No Retreat
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: AI units within 6” use the Villain’s Qua for Morale Tests if it’s better than their own, as long as the Villain isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Piercing Charge
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when charging.

specialRules.name: Reanimation
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule is activated, roll as many dice as the max. number of models/wounds it could restore. For each 5+ you may restore one model/wound. Note that new models may only be restored if they can be placed in coherency with non-restored models.

specialRules.name: Rending
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and for each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

specialRules.name: Relentless
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers to this weapon which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Slow
specialRules.description: Moves -2” when using Advance, and -4” when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Indirect
specialRules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Follows same rules as heroes, picking one random spell to cast, and spending all tokens to cast it when activated. If the chosen spell can’t be cast for any reason, then the model doesn’t cast.
